subject: Checking counsel timeline — FinLabs discovery + redlines
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposed next steps (FinLabs discovery)

Hi Ellie — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and the two asks I promised: 

1) What we heard (summary):
- Primary use case: real-time contract summarization for sales + CS, low latency under 300ms for 512-token responses.
- Data constraints: customer PII allowed, logs retained 90 days, SOC2 required.
- Scale: pilot ~50 agents, then 500 monthly active sessions.

2) Proposed next steps:
- I’ll spin up a short pilot estimate & infra plan (ETA: end of week).
- Legal/procurement: please share the internal contact who will take a look at standard SLA/contract language.
- Technical: we offered a short runtime demo for the CS team — does next Wed 12/8 work?

Attachments: discovery-notes-20261130.txt (notes from call)

If you want to loop anyone from procurement/counsel on this thread, that’d be great — otherwise I’ll follow up next week.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Gentle follow-up + redlines we received (attached)

Ellie — looping back. We just received redlines from Procurement at FinLabs (attached: FinLabs_Redlines_20261202.pdf) — thank you for moving that along. Two asks so we can keep momentum:

1) Can you confirm whether counsel expects a call to walk through redlines or prefers written responses? If a call, what windows look good this week?
2) Are there any non-negotiable SLA items in the redlines we should be aware of (data retention exceptions, encryption/HSM requirements, or uptime penalties)?

We’d like to surface anything that would materially change the pilot scope so we can adjust the SOW estimate. I’ve cc’d Marissa (contracts) and Vivek (solutions) to keep the right folks in the loop.

Attachments: FinLabs_Redlines_20261202.pdf (procurement redline packet)

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@finlabs.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gentle follow-up + redlines we received (attached)

Thanks Dylan — sorry for the slow turnaround. We pulled counsel in earlier and they prefer a short sync to talk through SLA carve-outs and encryption language (they’ve flagged two sections). Can you do a 30-min call tomorrow 12/4 between 10–12 PT? I’ll have our procurement lead on.

Non-negotiables: counsel indicated they’re highly sensitive about any permanent data retention beyond 90 days and want HSM/KMS details on key custody. They didn’t say no — just want clarity and concrete controls.

I’ll upload the signed NDA and the redline packet to the shared drive once procurement confirms.

— Ellie
